exports.createXaiVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildXaiVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { request, meta }; native and OpenAI-style fields; throws status 400
exports.resolveXaiTiming: (body) -> { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls } from timeout_ms / poll_interval_ms / max_polls; throws status 400
exports.xaiImageReference: public https or base64 data:image check for start/reference images
exports.runXaiVideoJob: create + bounded poll; { success, url, requestId, answer, accounting, identity } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.submitXaiVideoJob: one create POST to a fixed action URL; { requestId } or error result (acceptedJob when uncertain)
exports.settleXaiStatus: classify a status answer (pending / done / failed / unknown)
exports.xaiAcceptedJob: (jobState, meta) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.xaiCredential: (credentials) -> { token, mode: apikey|oauth } by connection authType
exports.openAIVideoStatus: CPA status mapping to queued / in_progress / completed / failed
exports.openAIVideoFromXaiCreate: OpenAI video object for an accepted create
exports.openAIVideoFromXaiStatus: OpenAI video object for a status answer (no upstream error text)
exports.resolveXaiVideoContent: GET /v1/videos/{id}/content -> public https URL via one status read; never downloads
exports.XAI_VIDEO_MODELS: video catalog metadata (id, name, kind, aliases, generateAudio)

provider.notCovered: grok-cli (OmniRoute's Grok Build OAuth proxy video entry) is a separate provider and is not staged here
